subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Proportional and Servo Valves
description: One-minute skill: Proportional and Servo Valves.

hook.text: A standard valve is either open or closed. A proportional valve opens any amount you ask — 10%, 47%, 83%.

buildup.text: An electric current moves the spool proportionally. More current means more opening. Flow scales smoothly.

discovery.text: Servo valves add feedback. They measure actual spool position and correct it thousands of times per second.

twist.text: Servo valves cost ten times more than proportional ones. But when a robotic arm needs micron accuracy, nothing else works.

climax.text: Flight simulators use servo hydraulics. The platform moves so precisely that pilots feel real flight forces.

punchline.text: Tell the valve exactly how much. It opens exactly that. Precision on demand.

quiz.question: What makes servo valves more precise than proportional valves?
options: They use stronger magnets to move the spool with more force
They include feedback that measures and corrects spool position continuously
They operate at higher pressures for finer control of flow
